description:
The Ford Raptor completely changed the performance-truck world when it arrived, and more than a decade later, finding a first-generation example in this kind of condition is becoming increasingly difficult.

This 2012 Ford F-150 SVT Raptor SuperCrew is finished in Black over a black interior and is absolutely gorgeous throughout. The body is exceptionally clean, the interior has been very well preserved, and underneath is just as impressive. There are no rust issues, and the underbody is remarkably clean, something that is getting harder and harder to find on these trucks.

Under the hood is Ford s legendary naturally aspirated 6.2-liter V8 producing 411 horsepower and 434 lb-ft of torque, paired with a six-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive. The 6.2L has developed an excellent reputation for durability and gives the first-generation Raptor the sound, response, and character that make these trucks so much fun to drive.

The Raptor was far more than an appearance package. Ford equipped these trucks with specially engineered long-travel suspension, FOX Racing shocks, a wider track, substantial ground clearance, and genuine high-speed off-road capability straight from the factory. This example is also nicely equipped with a power sunroof and premium Sony sound system, while a set of custom wheels gives it an aggressive stance without taking away from the unmistakable original Raptor design.

Condition is everything with a first-generation Raptor. So many have been heavily modified, used hard, or developed significant corrosion underneath. This is one of the nicest examples we've come across anywhere a beautiful, rust-free truck with an exceptionally clean body and undercarriage that clearly stands apart from the average Raptor on the market.

If you've been looking for a properly kept, naturally aspirated 6.2L V8 Raptor, this is the kind of example worth holding out for.

The 2014 Toyota Tundra SR5 offers a rugged blend of full-size capability and legendary Toyota reliability, finished in a classic Super White exterior. As part of the redesigned 2014 Tundra lineup, this truck features a chiseled new exterior with a taller, bolder grille and squared-off fenders for a commanding presence. Powered by the proven 5.7L i-Force V8 Flex Fuel engine delivering 381 horsepower and 401 lb-ft of torque, this capable truck provides exceptional towing power through its 6-speed automatic transmission with sequential shift mode and a robust 4WDemand part-time 4WD system with electronically controlled transfer case.

The well-equipped SR5 trim outfits the Tundra with distinctive 18-inch styled wheels wrapped in P255/70R18 tires, chrome grille surround, fog lights, and a chrome rear bumper. Inside, you'll find durable cloth seating surfaces with a 40/20/40 split fold-down front bench seat accommodating up to five passengers, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, and functional interior accents. The Double Cab configuration offers comfortable rear seating with 34.7 inches of rear legroom, along with a 6.5-foot double-walled bed with rail caps for versatile cargo capacity.

Advanced technology features include the Entune Audio Plus system with a 7-inch high-resolution touchscreen, Bluetooth hands-free phone and audio streaming, HD Radio with iTunes tagging, SiriusXM satellite radio (subscription required), USB and auxiliary inputs, and a standard rearview camera viewed through the audio display. The Tundra SR5 also boasts the comprehensive Star Safety System including Vehicle Stability Control, Traction Control, ABS with Electronic Brake-force Distribution, Brake Assist, and Smart Stop Technology, along with trailer sway control and the segment-exclusive standard backup camera.

Engineered for dependable work and legendary durability, this Tundra achieves an EPA-estimated 13 MPG city and 17-18 MPG highway (15 MPG combined) while offering a substantial 9,900 to 10,200 pounds of maximum towing capacity and a 1,520 to 1,595-pound payload when properly equipped.

Low miles 2013 Ram 1500 Tradesman is a full-size, light-duty work truck designed primarily for commercial use, fleet management, and budget-conscious buyers who prioritize structural capability over luxury. It serves as the baseline, entry-level model in the 2013 Ram lineup. []

Conceptual Design & Appeal

The core philosophy behind the Tradesman description is uncompromised utility and low cost of ownership. While consumer-oriented trims highlight high-end electronics, the Tradesman targets a demographic that needs a rugged mobile tool. It strips away expensive cosmetic enhancements (like chrome body panels and fragile interior fabrics) to reduce the initial retail cost and minimize long-term wear and tear. Because it shares the exact same strong high-strength steel chassis, hydroformed frame sections, and advanced 5-link coil rear suspension as the high-end luxury trims, it offers the exact same mechanical durability and towing performance at a much lower price point.

Exterior Styling

The exterior design can be summarized as functional and unadorned. It trades delicate visual accents for parts that are cheaper to fix or replace:

  • Front Facia: Built with a stark black upper fascia, a black Hex-Link grille template, and black front and rear bumpers that hide small work-site scratches.

  • Wheels: Rides on 17-inch styled steel wheels painted Argent, providing structural strength against potholes and rough terrain.

  • Bed Construction: Standard utility features include built-in bed rail caps and a locking tailgate integrated with a lift-assist mechanism to reduce physical strain.

Interior Atmosphere

Inside the cabin, the atmosphere mimics a heavy-duty workspace. It uses components optimized for quick cleaning and high physical resilience:

  • Seating: Standard front seating features a 40/20/40 split-bench layout wrapped in heavy-duty vinyl, designed to resist tearing, liquid spills, mud, and stains.

  • Flooring: Replaces traditional soft carpets with an all-weather black vinyl floor covering, allowing the driver to sweep or wash out the interior floor easily.

  • Dashes & Panels: Constructed using hard-touch, durable polymers that withstand prolonged UV sunlight exposure without cracking.

Powertrain & Driving Character

Unlike previous eras of baseline work trucks, the 2013 Tradesman includes a surprisingly high level of foundational driving technology. Even when configured with its entry-level engines, it benefits from a highly praised, smooth-shifting transmission setup, active automatic headlamps, and standard cruise control. Its coil-spring rear suspension layout completely transforms the typical bouncy, empty-bed driving dynamic of older trucks, delivering a compliant ride quality that resembles a large SUV more than a commercial flatbed

2016 Toyota Tacoma TRD Sport 4x4 | DOUBLE CAB | LONG BED | V6

Alright, let’s get this out of the way right up front...

Yes. It’s got miles.

It’s also a Toyota Tacoma.

Talking about mileage on a well-kept Tacoma is a little like worrying about wrinkles on Willie Nelson. At some point you realize that’s not age, that’s experience.

And this isn’t some bare-bones little work truck either.

This is a 2016 Tacoma TRD Sport 4x4 Double Cab LONG BED with the 3.5L V6, 6-speed automatic, Tow Package, navigation and a whole lot of Tacoma goodness wrapped up in Magnetic Gray Metallic.

In other words, Toyota didn’t build this one to sit around looking pretty.

Although...

It still looks pretty dang good.

The TRD Sport Package brings the attitude with the hood scoop, sport-tuned suspension, 17-inch machined alloy wheels, projector-beam headlights with LED daytime running lights and those unmistakable Tacoma looks.

And because this one is 4x4, when the pavement ends, the conversation doesn’t have to.

Got a boat?

Tow Package.

Got hunting gear?

Long bed.

Got kids?

Double Cab.

Got a buddy moving apartments?

Tell him you sold the truck.

You’ve got to establish boundaries somewhere.



Inside, this Tacoma originally came nicely equipped with:

TRD Sport Package
4x4
3.5L V6
6-Speed Automatic
Double Cab
Long Bed
Tow Package
Navigation
Entune Premium Audio
Push-Button Start
Wireless Phone Charging
Backup Camera
Bluetooth
SiriusXM Capability
Power Sliding Rear Glass
17" TRD Sport Alloy Wheels
Projector Headlights & LED Daytime Running Lights
Deck Rail System with Adjustable Tie-Down Cleats

That LONG BED deserves another mention, too.

Because finding a Double Cab Tacoma is easy.

Finding one with four doors, 4x4, the TRD Sport package AND the long bed?

Now we’re cooking with something hotter than grease.

And then there’s that Toyota V6.

No fancy speech needed.

Start it. Drive it. Listen to it.

This truck was built during an era when Toyota apparently looked at Tacoma owners and said:

“Y’all are probably gonna keep these things forever, aren’t you?”

Pretty much.

So if you’re the shopper who sees miles and immediately runs for the hills, this probably isn’t your truck.

But if you’re the shopper who understands that condition, maintenance history and how a truck has been cared for matter, then pull up a chair.

Because the odometer tells you how far it’s traveled.

It doesn’t tell you how much truck is left.

And with a Tacoma, that distinction matters.

This one originally stickered at $35,985, and it was ordered right: V6, TRD Sport, 4x4, Double Cab, Long Bed and Tow Package.

That’s not a grocery-getter pretending to be a pickup.

That’s a truck.

Come see this 2016 Toyota Tacoma TRD Sport 4x4 at Jim Hudson Cadillac of Augusta.

Take it for a drive.

Check out the condition.

Look over the history.

Then decide whether the miles bother you.

Because somewhere out there is a Tacoma owner with an odometer reading that would look like a Wi-Fi password, wondering what everybody is so worried about.

It’s a Tacoma, folks.

They don’t get old.

They just get stories.

2024 Chevrolet Colorado 2WD WT: Modern Efficiency Meets Versatile Capability

The factory-certified 2024 Chevrolet Colorado 2WD WT Crew Cab delivers midsize pickup versatility backed by modern engineering. Finished in striking Sand Dune Metallic over a Jet Black cloth interior, this truck offers a clean, purposeful look suited for everyday commuting or weekend projects. For drivers in El Reno needing a dependable truck for hauling equipment or handling light utility duties, this midsize pickup balances manageable dimensions with real work ethic. Explore our complete used truck inventory to discover how this certified Chevrolet fits your daily routine.

Performance & Capability

Under the hood, the 2024 Chevrolet Colorado is powered by a 2.7L I-4 direct injection, DOHC, variable valve control, intercooled turbo, regular gasoline engine with cylinder deactivation that produces 237HP. Paired with a smooth-shifting 8-speed automatic transmission and a 3.42 rear axle ratio, this rear-wheel drive setup delivers responsive acceleration while maintaining an efficient EPA-estimated 19 mpg city and 24 mpg highway rating. With a 5,800 lbs GVWR, regular grade rear leaf springs, and gas-pressurized shock absorbers, it remains steady whether loaded with supplies or cruising unladen. Drivers managing property in Kingfisher will appreciate the integrated CornerStep rear bumper step and Hitch Guidance vehicle to trailer hitching assist when loading cargo or securing light trailers. The truck rides on 17 x 8-inch Ultra Silver Metallic steel wheels wrapped in P255/65TR17 all-season tires, supported by StabiliTrak electronic stability control with proactive roll avoidance.

Technology & Connectivity

Inside the quiet cabin, advanced technology keeps you connected and secure on every trip. The centerpiece of the dashboard is an 11.3-inch diagonal advanced color LCD touchscreen display paired with an 11.0-inch digital gauge cluster. Seamless integration comes standard via wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto projection, Google Assistant built-in virtual assistant capability, and Bluetooth handsfree audio streaming through a 6-speaker sound system. Safety is equally comprehensive thanks to standard Chevy Safety Assist features, including Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Automatic Emergency Braking, and Front Pedestrian and Bicyclist Braking. Hitching up is simple with the HD Rear Vision Camera featuring Hitch View, while IntelliBeam automatic high beams optimize night vision.

Discover the 2017 Nissan Titan SV, a dependable pickup truck that balances power, comfort, and technology. With just over 54,137 miles, this vehicle offers a proven record of reliability and performance. Its striking Brilliant Silver exterior complements a sleek black interior, making it an attractive choice for drivers seeking a versatile workhorse or a capable family vehicle. Powered by a 5.6-liter V8 engine generating 390 horsepower and 394 lb-ft of torque, this Titan delivers impressive towing and hauling capabilities. The 7-speed shiftable automatic transmission and 4X4 drivetrain ensure smooth handling in a variety of conditions, whether you're navigating city streets or tackling off-road terrain. Fuel efficiency is reasonable for a truck of this size, with 15 mpg in the city and 21 mpg on the highway. Designed to seat six comfortably, with four doors and modern amenities, this used Titan SV is ready to meet your needs with Bluetooth connectivity, push start, and satellite radio compatibility, making every drive more enjoyable.

This Nissan Titan SV combines practicality with advanced features to enhance your driving experience. Stay connected on the road with hands-free phone call integration and voice-operated radio, ensuring convenience and safety. The vehicle is equipped with Pandora and iHeartRadio internet radio apps, providing a variety of entertainment options, while electronic messaging assistance with a read function and voice operation keeps you focused on the road. The sound system boasts six speakers for clear audio, and a USB auxiliary input allows easy connection of your devices. Whether you're commuting or on a long trip, these features offer entertainment and connectivity at your fingertips, making every journey more enjoyable.

2017 Nissan Titan Safety and Security Features

The Titan SV prioritizes safety with four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) to maintain control during hard stops. Power door locks include anti-lockout functionality, preventing you from getting locked out of the vehicle. Auto-locking doors add an extra layer of security, ensuring doors lock automatically when you're driving, giving peace of mind at all times.

2017 Nissan Titan Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment and technology are well-covered with voice-operated hands-free phone call integration, allowing you to stay connected without distraction. The radio system is also voice-operated for ease of use. The vehicle supports Pandora and iHeartRadio internet radio apps, providing access to a wide range of music and stations. Electronic messaging assistance with a read function and voice operation helps you stay connected while keeping your focus on the road. The audio system features six speakers, delivering clear sound throughout the cab, and a USB auxiliary input makes it simple to connect your devices for personalized playlists.

2017 Nissan Titan Performance Features

Performance is a key strength of the Titan SV, equipped with an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector that offers versatile control over traction. The vehicle features a part-time 4WD system, allowing you to engage the four-wheel drive mode when needed for challenging terrains or adverse weather conditions. These features work together to provide reliable handling and traction, whether you're hauling loads or navigating tough roads.

The 2019 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab Platinum offers a compelling blend of power, luxury, and advanced features, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a versatile pickup. With just over 156,500 miles, this used model showcases Ford’s renowned 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged V6 engine delivering 375 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque, paired with a smooth 10-speed automatic transmission with Sport Mode. Its 4X4 drivetrain ensures confident handling across varied terrains, while the gray exterior and black leather interior exude sophistication. This truck comes loaded with modern conveniences such as Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, cross traffic alert, navigation, heated and rear heated seats, keyless entry, push start, satellite radio, and a WiFi hotspot. The spacious four-door cabin comfortably seats five, making it perfect for workdays or family outings. Fuel efficiency stands at 17 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway, balancing power with economy.

Designed for safety and convenience, this Ford F-150 Platinum is equipped with advanced security features. It includes inflatable seatbelts at the rear for enhanced occupant protection, rear parking sensors, four-wheel ABS, and an interior motion sensor anti-theft system. Anti-tow sensors and programmable safety keys add further security, while emergency braking preparation and cornering brake control support safe driving. Power door locks feature auto-locking and anti-lockout functions, ensuring the vehicle remains secure. These features collectively provide peace of mind, whether parked or on the move.

2019 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab Safety and Security Features

This model prioritizes safety with inflatable rear seatbelts and rear parking sensors, enhancing occupant protection and facilitating safer parking. Four-wheel ABS improves braking performance in varied conditions, while the interior motion sensor anti-theft system deters unauthorized access. Anti-tow sensors prevent theft of the vehicle, and emergency braking preparation offers additional safety during sudden stops. Power door locks with auto-locking and anti-lockout functions ensure security, complemented by cornering brake control for improved handling. The programmable safety key adds a layer of customization and security, making this truck a reliable choice for everyday use.

2019 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab Entertainment and Technology Features

This Ford F-150 Platinum features a premium B&O PLAY audio system with 750 watts and a total of nine speakers, delivering high-quality sound throughout the cabin. The 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system provides a user-friendly interface with HD radio and voice-operated controls for radio and hands-free phone calls. FordPass Connect compatibility allows smartphone integration for remote vehicle management, engine start, and cabin preconditioning. The system supports smart device app functions and offers seamless connectivity, making every drive enjoyable and connected.

2019 Ford F-150 SuperCrew Cab Performance Features

Performance is key with this F-150, which includes auto start/stop technology for improved fuel economy and an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector for versatile driving modes. The part-time 4WD system with on-demand setting allows drivers to switch between two-wheel and four-wheel drive as needed, ensuring optimal traction and handling in any condition. These features combine to provide a capable, responsive driving experience suited for work, recreation, or daily commuting.

description: BOLD, HEMI-POWERED, WELL EQUIPPED, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, READY FOR WORK AND PLAY! The fifth-generation Ram 1500 raised the bar for full-size pickups, and this 2019 Ram 1500 Big Horn Crew Cab 4x4 shows exactly why. Finished in Diamond Black Crystal Pearlcoat with chrome accents and 20-inch chrome-clad wheels, it was ordered with the 5.7-liter HEMI V8, the Level 2 Equipment Group, and the Premium LED Lighting Group, adding the comfort and technology that make this truck as pleasant to drive every day as it is capable on the job. With only about 55,100 miles on the odometer, this Ram has averaged fewer than 7,000 miles per year, well below typical usage for a truck of its age. It comes from a single owner and arrives off-lease, and it has been fitted with running boards and a set of aggressive all-terrain tires that add both convenience and rugged capability. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The fifth-generation Ram 1500 earned widespread acclaim for delivering a ride quality and interior refinement that few full-size trucks can match. Its coil-spring rear suspension provides a smooth, composed ride whether the bed is empty or loaded, while its strong, lightweight frame and aluminum body components help maximize capability. Shoppers also appreciate the Ram's thoughtfully designed cabin, with a spacious Crew Cab that comfortably seats adults in the rear and clever storage solutions throughout. Paired with the legendary 5.7-liter HEMI V8, the Big Horn delivers the ideal balance of power, comfort, and value for truck buyers who want it all. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers praised the fifth-generation Ram 1500 for its class-leading ride comfort, upscale and spacious interior, strong HEMI V8 performance, and intuitive Uconnect technology, with many calling it the most refined full-size pickup on the market at launch. That combination earned the 2019 Ram 1500 the MOTOR TREND 2019 TRUCK OF THE YEAR and the 2019 NORTH AMERICAN TRUCK OF THE YEAR. Warranty The odometer currently shows 55,129 miles. This Ram was originally registered in September 2018, so its original factory coverage has naturally run its course. What makes it stand out is how lightly it has been used: averaging fewer than 7,000 miles per year, it has covered far less ground than a typical truck of its age, and it comes from a single owner as an off-lease vehicle. Standard Features The Big Horn is the sweet spot of the Ram 1500 lineup, stepping up from the work-focused Tradesman with chrome exterior accents, upgraded interior materials, and more convenience features. Its Crew Cab body offers full-size rear doors and generous rear-seat legroom, making it a genuine family vehicle as well as a capable pickup. Everyday conveniences include a ParkView rear back-up camera, keyless entry, cruise control, power windows and locks, and a spacious interior with smart storage solutions throughout. The Big Horn's chrome grille and bumpers give it a classic, upscale truck look. Installed Options This Ram was ordered with an impressive list of factory upgrades that add power, comfort, technology, and style. Level 2 Equipment Group Heated front seats and heated steering wheel Keep you comfortable on cold mornings and during winter work days. Uconnect 4 with 8.4-inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto A large, responsive display that brings your smartphone's apps, music, and navigation right onto the screen. Dual-zone automatic temperature control Lets the driver and front passenger each set their own preferred temperature. ParkSense front and rear park assist with stop Alerts you to obstacles and can automatically apply the brakes at low speeds, making maneuvering this full-size truck much easier. Remote start system Warm up or cool down the cabin before you ever step outside. Power 8-way driver's seat with power lumbar and power-adjustable pedals Makes it easy for drivers of any size to find a comfortable, well-positioned driving setup. Class IV receiver hitch and dampened tailgate Ready for towing right from the factory, with a tailgate that lowers gently instead of dropping. Power-folding mirrors with supplemental signals and courtesy lamps Fold in easily for tight spaces and add visibility and convenience at night. Rear power sliding window, 7-inch color instrument cluster display, universal garage door opener, and media hub Practical upgrades that make everyday driving more convenient. Premium LED Lighting Group LED reflector headlamps, LED front fog lamps, and LED taillamps Brighter, clearer illumination for nighttime driving, along with a sharper, more modern look. Standalone Features 5.7-liter HEMI V8 engine with Active Noise Control Strong, smooth V8 power for towing and passing, with a quieter cabin at cruising speeds. 20-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels A bold, polished look that pairs beautifully with the black paint. Deluxe cloth front bucket seats Comfortable, supportive individual front seats in place of a bench. Diamond Black Crystal Pearlcoat paint A deep, glossy black finish with a subtle pearl shimmer. Aftermarket Equipment Photos show several additions that do not appear on the factory option list. RAM-branded side steps with polished finishes run along both sides of the cab, making it easier to climb in and out of this tall truck. The truck also wears Nitto Recon Grappler A/T all-terrain tires in a larger LT295/55R20 size than the original equipment, giving it a more rugged stance and added traction on dirt, gravel, and snow, and black mud flaps help protect the lower body from road debris. As with any aftermarket equipment, we encourage buyers to inspect these additions in person. Truck Capability The 5'7'' box measures approximately 67 inches long at the floor and 66 inches wide, with roughly 51 inches between the wheel wells, giving plenty of room for camping gear, landscaping supplies, or weekend toys, while the shorter box keeps this Crew Cab easier to park and maneuver than long-bed trucks. Because the axle ratio is not shown on the supplied option list, towing and payload figures here are estimates. With the standard 3.21 axle ratio, a comparably equipped 2019 Ram 1500 Big Horn Crew Cab 4x4 with the 5.7-liter HEMI is rated to tow approximately 7,700 pounds, with payload estimated at roughly 1,500 to 1,700 pounds, though the larger aftermarket tires and running boards will reduce the actual figure somewhat. The factory Class IV receiver hitch makes this Ram ready to pull boats, campers, and utility trailers right away. Mechanical Features The 5.7-liter HEMI V8 produces 395 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque, delivering the strong, confident acceleration and deep V8 rumble that HEMI owners love. Variable valve timing sharpens throttle response, while the fuel-saving Multi-Displacement System quietly shuts down four cylinders when cruising to help improve highway efficiency. The TorqueFlite 8-speed automatic transmission delivers smooth, quick shifts, and four-wheel drive provides added traction on snowy roads, muddy job sites, and boat ramps. Ram's coil-spring rear suspension delivers a smooth, controlled ride, and Active Noise Control helps keep the cabin quiet when cruising. Exterior Features Diamond Black Crystal Pearlcoat gives this Ram a deep, commanding presence, and the Big Horn's chrome grille, chrome bumpers, and 20-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels add bold, polished contrast. LED reflector headlamps, LED fog lamps, and LED taillamps give it a crisp, modern look day or night. Power-folding mirrors with supplemental turn signals and courtesy lamps, a rear power sliding window, and a dampened tailgate add everyday practicality, while RAM-branded side steps and all-terrain tires give this truck a confident, capable stance. Interior Features Inside, the Crew Cab offers generous space for five, with deluxe black cloth front bucket seats and a comfortable rear bench with ample legroom. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel take the chill off winter mornings, and dual-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable. The power 8-way driver's seat with power lumbar support and power-adjustable pedals make it easy to find the perfect driving position, while the 7-inch color instrument cluster display keeps key information in view. Thoughtful storage throughout the cabin keeps tools and everyday essentials organized. Infotainment & Technology Uconnect 4 with an 8.4-inch touchscreen provides intuitive control of audio, phone, and vehicle settings, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring your smartphone's apps right onto the screen. The media hub offers USB ports for charging and connectivity, and a single-disc CD player is also included. SiriusXM satellite radio capability is also included. Subscription may be required to maintain service. Safety Features This Ram is equipped with a strong suite of safety technology. ParkSense front and rear park assist with automatic stop helps prevent low-speed collisions, and the ParkView rear back-up camera makes parking and hitching trailers easier. Electronic Stability Control, Trailer Sway Damping, Hill Start Assist, four-wheel anti-lock disc brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system round out a well-rounded safety package. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Ram 1500 Big Horn combines legendary HEMI V8 power with genuine everyday comfort, from heated seats and a heated steering wheel to Uconnect 4 with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. With below-average mileage for its age, a single-owner history, factory towing capability, and a rugged set of all-terrain tires, it is ready for whatever the work week or weekend brings. Chrome wheels, black paint, and a HEMI up front -- this Ram looks just as good hauling a boat as it does parked in the driveway.
